text: 明晟公司MSCI新兴市场股票指数涨1.8%，发展中国家外汇指数涨0.4%。 巴西股市创2020年以来最佳单日表现，投资者关注总统候选人博索纳罗在第一轮选举中领先总统卢拉。 巴西圣保罗证交所指数收涨7.70%，报20.7万点，里约热内卢盘初迅猛拉涨、绝大部分时间高位企稳。 巴西雷亚尔兑美元涨4.21%，报4.9931雷亚尔，盘中整体高位企稳、持续交投于4.99雷亚尔附近。
text_en: MSCI's emerging markets stock index rose 1.8%, and the developing-nation currency index rose 0.4%. Brazilian stocks posted their best single-day performance since 2020 as investors focused on presidential candidate Bolsonaro leading President Lula in the first round of the election. The Bovespa index in Sao Paulo closed up 7.70% at 207,000 points, with Rio de Janeiro surging sharply early and stabilizing at high levels for most of the session. The Brazilian real rose 4.21% against the dollar to 4.9931 reais, holding broadly at high levels intraday and trading persistently around 4.99 reais.
